description:
A simple, unremarkable weapon used by
Knights.

A cheap but effective piercing weapon used
by Rogues.

A holy staff bestowed to all apprentice
Clerics.

This crude wooden implement gently hums
with energy.

Interlocking metal plates create this sturdy
Knight's armor.

These weathered leather clothes offer slight
protection.

This lightweight cloak protects against the
wind and little else.

The holder of this tome has their ability
cooldowns shortened by 3 sec.

The wearer of this ring slowly regenerates
health at all times.

A crude but effective weapon.  Hope you've
had your shots!

A versatile and well-made blade, widely
used by Knights.

These were designed for chopping trees, not
for battle.

Bestows upon the wearer a +3 bonus to
attack power.

These rugged gauntlets provide a +6 power
bonus to the wearer.

Infused with the strength of demigods,
granting a +10 power bonus.

A magic-infused ring that grants +3 magic
power to its wearer.

This gemstone glistens with arcane fire.
Grants +6 magic power.

A powerful wizard's soul resides within the
crimson jewel... +10 magic power.

These nimble boots allow the wearer to run
10% faster.

The wearer of this amulet is granted rapid
health regeneration.

Provides a 10% chance for attacks to deflect
off of the wearer.

A field of energy protects the wearer of this
gem, negating 20% of attacks.

A symbol of strength and luck - grants a 15%
critical strike chance.

This eye-piece grants impossibly accurate
vision, and 10% critical chance.
This bracer grants an armor bonus of +3.

The bearer of this magic stone gains a +6
armor bonus.

The mighty soul of Sharkul lies within!
Increases armor by +10.

Grants the wearer astounding swiftness, 
increasing run speed by 20%.

Lucky!  Grants 5% critical strike chance to
your attacks.

Grants the wearer 5% increased attack or
casting speed.

The swirling energy of this jewel grants 10%
increased attack/cast speed.

Behold the blinding speed of the ninja!  +15%
attack/casting speed.

The secrets of this ancient text reduce the
owner's cooldowns by 6 sec.

Grants a 5% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

Grants a 10% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

Grants a 15% chance for an activated power
to invoke no cooldown.

While worn, the party will receive 10% extra
gold from battles.

While worn, the party will receive 20% extra
gold from battles.

Gives a bonus of +10% increased XP to the
owner.

What's inside? A baby dragon? Cream filling?
Grants +20% increased XP.

Once worn by bloodthirsty berserkers, grants
10% life-draining to attacks.

This vile fang grants the wearer a 20% life-
draining effect on their attacks.

Evil whispers emanate from the center jewel.
Grants 30% life-draining to attacks.

Popular among bare-fisted fighters, such as
the Monk.

Designed for freedom of movement, allowing
quick evasion.

Everyday lute strings, typically made from
intestine linings, ew!

Grants a 5% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

Grants a 10% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

Grants a 15% bonus to all healing received
by the wearer.

A finely crafted silver blade, from a well-
known smith.

Most likely the former property of some
ne're-do-well.

This blade hums with subtle magical energy
and light.

Blades such as these are said to be able to
slay spirits...

A relic from a lost civilization, it still holds
untold power.

A savage weapon made from the teeth and
bones of wyverns.
As deadly and remorseless as winter itself.

Each of this cursed blade's owners have
been driven mad.

Typically wielded in two hands... but not if
you're a hero.

Serrated and razor sharp - carves monsters
into bits!

Swords such as these are often forged by
by fey spirits.

The blade glistens with otherworldly light
and power.

Relic of the goddess, M'ir, vigilant protector
of all good souls.

This once evil blade has been cleansed by
holy rites.

These gloves provide increased punching
power.
Are these legal?  Probably not.

Few can withstand a blow from these cruel
implements.

A simple cloth that has been enchanted with
elemental magics.

Righteous fury fills these gloves with purpose
and power.

A relic from an ancient order of monks that
has since vanished.

Crafted by assassins, these gloves hold
murderous power.

Channels the might and fury of an ancient
imperial dynasty.

Not literally silver, but they shine with a
distinct luster.

These finely crafted strings provide superior
clarity and tone.

Imbued with subtle magic that enhances
their sound.

Grants an almost supernatural capacity to 
make the ladies swoon.

Dragons don't just make great wallets, but
also lute strings?

Their origin unknown, these strings create
unimaginable clarity.

These mysterious strings bear a curious aura
of sadness about them.

These strings resonate with the very soul of
all who hear them.

A popular choice amongst dual-wielding
barbarians.

These savage blades have a nasty serrated
edge.

Absurdly heavy stones on sticks - primitive
but effective.

Perfectly balanced, these axes are built for
combat.

Petrified by a supernatural chill, they strike
with immense force.

It is said the wounds these blades leave are
cursed to never heal.

Fashioned by dwarves, they exhibit long lost
crafstmanship.

Adorned with skulls, these towering swords
herald the end times.

Helps to channel divine power with greater
ease.

Crafted from the wood of ancient, blessed
groves.

Favored amongst scryers, these staves can
peer into the future.

A symbol of the holy circle of M'ir and its
high clerics.

Granted only to those who show great
compassion and piety.

The floating crystals that form this rod gently
hum with power.

This artifact is said to channel the very will
of the Sun King.

It's origin unknown, this artifact emits waves
of peace and calm.
Often confused with a simple walking stick.

These staves channel natural energies with
ease.
Chaotic energy swirls within the focus stone.

This staff appears to house a malevolent
spirit inside.

Exhibits exceptional capacity for channeling
the elements.
This staff bears a terrible, cursed aura.

This staff is fashioned in the image of a
serpent god.

These staves are only bestowed to the most
powerful of mages.

Turns the wearer into a walking tank... a very
slowly walking tank.

Crafted from the finest mithril, known for its
magical strength.
The sanctified armor of the Templar order.
Instills great courage in those who wear it.

Empowers the wearer with the strength of
100 fallen heroes.

Crafted by wood-folk, these cloaks are light-
weight and rugged.

Embroidered with runes and infused with
defensive magics.
It shimmers with an unnatural light.

Grants divine protection to those who are
steadfast and resolute.

Forbidden magic courses through the dark
fabric.

Reinforced with metal studs for added
protection.

This lightweight armor was inscribed by
clerics and mages.

Infuses the wearer with the crazed spirit of
the barbarian.

These dark clothes course with sinister,
shadowy magic.

None can stand against the unyielding force
of the blademaster.

Emblazoned with the image of a mighty
dragon spirit.

A symbol of one who has attained great skill
and respect.

Garments worn by the clan of the iron body,
masters of self defense.

Grants the wearer legendary swiftness and
skill.

Worn only by true masters of the martial
arts.

A simple bow used to hunt small game
animals.

This compact bow is easy to handle and
packs a punch.

Its design provides increased range and
power.

Fashioned from magical trees, this weapon
glows with energy.

Its lightweight, camouflaged design make it
ideal for assassins.

Crafted from the bone and tissues of a fallen
dragon.

These bows are typically only found in the
hands of elite royal snipers.

This weapon is engraved with elven songs
of war.

A bow said to house the force of 10,000
unrelenting storms.
